'''1999 Decipher World Championship Martin Akesson LS''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Martin Akesson]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls92.htm Akesson Hidden Base], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]).
